A '''Beemon package''' was a high-powered [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]] that was used to override an [[Species/Legends|organic being's]] natural reactions to injuries, pain, and stress. The implant allowed [[Cyborg/Legends|users]] to endure larger amounts of physical exertion and injuries than would usually be possible. Anyone who used a cyber reaction system required a large amount of training with implants before they were strong enough to handle the implant's effects. The implant was [[Color/Legends|colored]] red over most of its surface, with lighter shades closer to the edges.<ref name="KotOR" />

Beemon packages were produced by<ref name="KotOR" /> [[Beemon Laboratories]]<ref name="Beemon" /> and were high-grade implants when in use during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] surrounding the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KotOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="KotORDate" /> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Tyvark Luowan]] had a Beemon package that he was selling for the price of 7,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at his [[Tyvark Luowan's Rodian Surprises|store]] in [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="KotOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Beemon package first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, its only appearance was as a purchasable item at the shop of the merchant Tyvark Luowan in Ahto City on Manaan. It was a level-three implant in the game and gave the user a bonus to his or her constitution attribute.<ref name="KotOR" />
